name: chispaconcalma
description: Chispa con Calma website and local content research

scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts/staging scripts/deployment scripts/releases scripts/git-hooks tests astro.config.mjs cloudflare.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts/staging scripts/deployment scripts/releases scripts/git-hooks tests astro.config.mjs cloudflare.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm format:check && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.staging:dry-run: node scripts/staging/add-headers.mjs dist && node scripts/deployment/build-protected.mjs staging dist && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode staging --dry-run
